berlin-motorcycle-escapes-spreewald-cana.story: Scenery first, traffic last, with checkpoints that make sense on a bike. 336 km round from Bernau bei Berlin - plan on about 7 h of riding. On the way it passes Lindow, near Nauen, near Trebbin and Marienfelde. The climb of the day is near Spreenhagen. Much of it runs through woodland.

sections.advice: Treat Food stop near Nauen → Photo stop near Trebbin as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.
Photo stop near Trebbin → Marienfelde is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

Use High point near Spreenhagen → Scenic stretch near Petershagen as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.

scenicChapters.title: Former hacienda of Ciénega de Mata → Historic centre of the city of La
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 60 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-historic-ensemble-of-the-town-of-.story: 376 km from Ojuelos de Jalisco to Ojuelos de Jalisco, about 6 h 29 of riding. The stops in between: Former hacienda of Ciénega de Mata, Historic centre of the city of Lagos de Mo, Cemetery in Encarnación de Díaz and Former hacienda of Cieneguilla. The highest point is about 2,250 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

tw-north-cross-island-highway.slogan: North Cross-Island Highway – 49 km between Daxi and Yilan

legend-norwegian-scenic-route-gamle-stry.story: Norwegian Scenic Route. historic mountain road, glaciers, stone walls. The highest point is about 1,300 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Geiranger-Trollstigen Norwegian Scenic Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Geiranger-Trollstigen Norwegian Scenic Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
